responsibility: VxWorks-specific stack-introspection helper for the GNAT runtime. It implements the single imported routine used by Ada stack-checking support on VxWorks to query the currently executing task via taskInfoGet/taskIdSelf, then return that task’s stack size, base, and end addresses in a small C record for consumption by the Ada side (notably System.Stack_Checking.Operations), making it the target hook that exposes per-task stack boundaries needed for runtime stack checking.
